Description: The activity is concerned with manufacturing of lactose and casein as follows: - Lactose or milk sugar is adisaccharide that results from the bonding of glucose sugar and galactose sugar. It is found mainly in milk and its derivatives. Centrifuges are used as part of a series of washing steps to obtain pure lactose. Lactose is used in many industries, including: • Lactose is used as a suitable medium for the growth of penicillium mushrooms for the purpose of producing penicillin. • Linking flavors and smells in the food industry. • Manufacturing low-sugar foods. • Increase product life, storage capacity for extended periods, and other uses. - Casein is a solid protein found in cow's milk. It is manufactured using the same technology as lactose production. Casein has many uses, including: Weight control, muscle growth, etc.

One of the widely-used tools for this kind of processing is the “Pipelines Inspection Gauge (PIG) of pipelines it is a tool that is used inside the pipelines and is propelled by pressing the passing product inside of pipelines itself. There are four main uses of these tools: 1. Physical separation between different liquids are transported inside pipelines 2. Internal cleaning procedure for pipelines 3. Description: The activity is concerned with making rice and preparing it for consumption by applying the following processes: First: cleaning and grading: the basis of the cleaning process is the exclusion or separation of any other components that may be mixed with rice from gravel, sand and others. Second: Peeling: The purpose of the peeling process is to separate the outer shell from the rice without cracking the peeled rice grains. The peeling process is done under the influence of shear stresses, pressure and friction on the surface of the rice grains. Third: Separation and sorting of rice: The products of the peeling process are peeled rice, unshelled rice and other things. These products are sifted to separate unshelled rice from the rice. Fourth: Bleaching: The bleaching process means removing dark layers, and this process is done by scratching or friction. Fifth: Polishing: The benefit of this stage is to give the rice a shiny surface.

Description (Arabic): الإنسان الآلي هو عامل الاصطناعية الميكانيكية أو الظاهرية، وعادة آلة كهروميكانيكية التي تداربواسطة برنامج كمبيوتر أو دوائر الإلكترونية. الروبوتات يمكن أن تكون مستقلة، أو شبه مستقلة أومتحكم فيها عن بعد ومن فئة الإنسان الآلي أنواع عدة منها الشبية بالبشر ومنها الصناعي. والتقليد المشابه للواقع للإنسان الآلي بحركات تشغيل آلية يمنح التعبيرعن مفهوم الذكاء أو الفكر من تلقاء نفسه. لمحاكاة هي تقليد لعمل عملية في العالم الحقيقي أو النظام مع مرور الوقت.فعل المحاكاة شئ يتطلب أولا تطوير نموذج. يتم استخدام المحاكاة في العديد من السياقات، مثل محاكاة التكنولوجيا من أجل تحسين الأداء، وهندسة السلامة، والاختبار، والتدريب، والتعليم، وألعاب الفيديو. أجهزة محاكاة التدريب تشمل محاكاة للطيران علي طائرة تدريب الطيارين لتوفر لهم تجربة مماثلة للواقع . كما يستخدم المحاكاة عندما لا يمكن تطبيق النظام الحقيقي علي أرض الواقع ، لصعوبة ذلك أو للخطورة ، أو يجري تصميم النظام ولكن لم يبنى بعد، أو النظام علي أرض الواقع ببساطة غير موجود.

Activity Name: Sugar Refining and Sugar Substitutes Manufacturing

Description: The activity is concerned with refining of sugar (sucrose) and sugar substitutes extracted from cane juice of cane, beet, maple and palm trees. Sugar is produced as follows: - The reeds are ground to obtain brown juice, in addition to sugar-wrapping, or the so-called bagasse. - The juice is separated from the bagasse by using specialized filters - The resulting sap is purified by heating it, and limestone is added to remove impurities. - The juice is transferred to the evaporator, to produce sugar crystals. - Mix the succulents and crystals in the centrifuge for separation. - Crystals are cooled and dried, resulting in brown sugar -Brown sugar undergoes continuous refining processes that lead to the removal of molasses contained in it, so that white sugar is obtained Similar operations are performed on beet juice, maple, and palm to obtain sugar.
